fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Workspace.

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Server-stamped ACL: IAM user ids that may read the row.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Project.

fields.name: Number
fields.description: Sequence number within the project.

fields.name: Area
fields.description: Technical area. One of: stack|architecture|integration|nfr|security|data|hosting|other.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Short decision title.

fields.name: Choice
fields.description: The chosen option.

fields.name: Rationale
fields.description: Why the option was chosen.

fields.name: Alternatives
fields.description: Options that were considered.

fields.name: NfrCategory
fields.description: Non-functional requirement category (area nfr), or empty.

fields.name: NfrTarget
fields.description: Non-functional requirement target (area nfr), or empty.

fields.name: IntegrationSystem
fields.description: External system name (area integration), or empty.

fields.name: ExpertUserIds
fields.description: IAM user ids of the experts consulted.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Decision status. One of: proposed|accepted|rejected|superseded.

fields.name: DecidedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the decider.

fields.name: DecidedAt
fields.description: When the decision was made.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: SeedKey
fields.description: Seed key <workspaceId>:<scenario>:<key> of an example record, stamped by the server; unique index.
